title: AI disclosures to workflow evidence: six questions a buyer can check
summary: A reusable evidence checklist for one agent workflow, derived as CSOAI analysis after reviewing public AI-company disclosures.
scope: Selected public-document sections reviewed. No issuer, model or customer deployment was tested or scored.

questions.question: What exact task and deployment does the evidence cover?
questions.retain: System and model version, tool versions, configuration, test inputs, expected output and actual returned artifact.
questions.control: A result for a different version or task must not satisfy this request.

questions.question: Did actions stay within the authority granted?
questions.retain: Allowed actions, relevant approval or refusal, tool requests, execution log and observed effects.
questions.control: In a controlled fixture, a declined or out-of-scope action must remain unexecuted.

questions.question: Was the environment actually bounded as declared?
questions.retain: Observed network and tool restrictions, permitted targets, environment configuration and containment checks.
questions.control: A harmless test against an operator-owned blocked destination must demonstrate the restriction; no third-party intrusion.

questions.question: Can a recipient verify and reopen the same evidence?
questions.retain: Original artifact, digest, named signing key where a signature exists, verification result and retained bytes.
questions.control: Change one byte in a copy and check that the integrity verification rejects it; keep the original.

questions.question: Did the returned work satisfy independently stated requirements?
questions.retain: Expected results, actual values, checker version, failures, omissions and unsupported features.
questions.control: A deliberately wrong result and an unrelated passing artifact must not be accepted as this delivery.

questions.question: What change invalidates the result or requires another check?
questions.retain: Original scope and date, expiry or change conditions, correction history and any later result linked to the same finding.
questions.control: A changed deployment or an unrelated retest must not silently close the original finding.
